glossary.definition: (1) "Reinstatement fees" means the fees that are required under section 4507.1612 , 4507.45 , 4509.101 , 4509.81 , 4511.191 , 4511.951 , or any other provision of the Revised Code, or under a schedule established by the bureau of motor vehicles, in order to reinstate a driver's or commercial driver's license or permit or nonresident operating privilege of an offender under a suspension.
